approvals.what: Design tokens come from Design/design-system/ (founder populated the folder mid-session)
Mascot 3D approach: pre-rendered PNGs + parallax at launch; live R3F slot reserved for when a GLB exists
Pre-order tool: Tally (6 fields: parent name, email, WhatsApp number, WhatsApp consent, child's birth month, city)
Concept round format: 3 full-scroll styled homepage concepts (HTML), founder picks one before build
Overall plan: concept round -> blueprint -> sprint build with milestone pauses

Concept direction: A (Storybook) as base, blended with Concept C elements/sections (explicit: C's 'Reserve Lumi before the price goes up' orange finale with character lineup; plus C-style bold moments where they strengthen A)
Mascot appears as a dimensional (3D-feeling) character throughout the site: renders with parallax/pointer-tilt/float on every page; live R3F slot preserved for when a GLB exists
NEW deliverable: launch video built with Remotion (teaser using mascot renders, brand tokens, one-idea copy, reserve CTA)

2D-to-3D pipeline: Tripo3D via REST API (founder subscribing). Key in repo-root .env as TRIPO_API_KEY. Multi-view mascot conversion -> rigged GLB -> Draco -> R3F slot. Renders+parallax remain the shipped fallback until GLB quality is founder-approved.

Tripo3D via UI (founder logged into tripo3d.ai in Chrome; no API key). Starter plan: spend conservatively. Sequence approved: mascot multi-view conversion + rig + 1 idle animation first, founder judges, then more (Lumi toy model etc.). 3D on site stays SUBTLE.
Launch video formats: 16:9 (1920x1080) + 9:16 vertical (1080x1920). v1 uses 2D cutouts; v2 may add 3D turntable after GLB approval.

Keyword validation: Google Trends India + autocomplete + People-also-ask via Chrome (no Keyword Planner). Goal: 10/10 SEO + AEO (FAQ schema, question-led headings, citable answer blocks) + GEO. Conversion-first copywriting per build prompt (re-read website-builder-prompt-final-kheelona.md when drafting).
